propositions: On fresh upgrade (store file absent), backfill must create confirmation records for all managed refs with bound targets, marked with source=backfill and direction=backfill, to prevent the first post-upgrade pass from declining every legitimate peer deletion.

Backfill must skip managed refs whose targets are unbound and must not re-run once the store file exists (even if empty), requiring a was_absent flag to distinguish fresh upgrade from legitimate empty state.
Backfill must never downgrade provenance: it skips keys already carrying push or snapshot records, while later snapshot confirmation can overwrite backfilled records in the same pass.

The evidence step (_confirm_peer_links) must use a single store instance opened once, run backfill first, then snapshot confirmation on the same instance, then save once if either wrote, to ensure backfilled records are visible for same-pass provenance upgrade and to prevent lost-update races.
